peerEvidence.observation: 0.14.1 NEWS describes R2004/AC1018 DWG writing as newly implemented and says R2007/AC1021 encoding falls back to R2010/AC1024; the release history also includes decompression, container, and security fixes.
peerEvidence.evidenceCeiling: Maintainer-published project release notes; no peer runtime or output was tested.
peerEvidence.disposition: Keep direction/version matrix rows separate and observe actual output AC code rather than assuming the requested writer version was produced.

peerEvidence.observation: README separates DXF/DWG read/write by version (including no AC1021 DWG writer). Current issue reports describe table loss/output rejection, missing VisualStyle/Material root objects affecting TrueView, and a prior silent ACIS DXF omission.
peerEvidence.evidenceCeiling: Published compatibility matrix and user/maintainer issue reports; they are not normative rules or libdxfrw reproductions.
peerEvidence.disposition: Map to existing PAR-126/PAR-20 graph and native-acceptance gates; do not infer local failure or add duplicate tests without a local source gap.

peerEvidence.observation: The README advertises broad DXF/DWG read/write ranges. Open issue reports separately describe unknown-class/proxy-graphic loss on DWG-to-DXF, BricsCAD rejection of a DXF-to-DWG output despite a direct DWG-to-DWG path opening, page/section size allocations before validation, malformed object-size/count behavior, and malformed-header panic behavior.
peerEvidence.evidenceCeiling: Issue-reported behavior and mutable main-branch documentation; no reports were independently reproduced, and no sample was fetched.
peerEvidence.disposition: Require exact route and stage labeling, per-object disposition, bounded-size/error behavior, and independent target acceptance; preserve existing PAR-06/PAR-07/PAR-14/PAR-49/PAR-132 gates.

peerEvidence.observation: Documentation states that unsupported ACIS structures are loaded as NONE_ENTITY with data loss and cannot be arbitrarily re-exported; proxy graphics expose display content but exploding destroys original proxy meaning.
peerEvidence.evidenceCeiling: DXF parser/documentation boundary only; not a DWG parser or general B-rep kernel.
peerEvidence.disposition: Keep raw carrier, display graphics, interpreted subset, semantic geometry, and native acceptance as distinct observations under PAR-07/S8 and PAR-59.

implementationReadiness.localApplicability: Reviewed peer reports map to existing PAR-06/PAR-07/S8/PAR-14/PAR-20/PAR-49/PAR-59/PAR-126/PAR-132/PAR-144 gates. Named reader ceilings exist, but this was not an exhaustive audit of every file-derived allocation or conversion.
implementationReadiness.nextLocalSlice: Continue PAR-144 by binding decoded BLOCK_RECORD ownership references to actual emitted entity-frame handles, then walk AC1015 first/last chain terminators and verify following-frame alignment.
implementationReadiness.validationPolicy: Run the owning fast test and scoped diff/receipt checks per slice; reserve full suites and one exact-pinned independent/native check for composed checkpoints. Self-unblock when external evidence is unavailable.
